text: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants for bachelor's degree programs must possess a high school diploma or equivalent, with excellent academic performance, and are generally under the age of 25. 2.Applicants must not be recipients of any other scholarship funding established by Chinese governments at various levels or the host university.Applicants must also meet the relevant enrollment requirements specified in the "Chinese Government Scholarship Application Guide". 3.Applicants for bachelor's degree programs must pass the comprehensive admission interview conducted by the School of Overseas Education of Guizhou Medical University; admission is competitive based on the comprehensive interview assessment. (The bachelor's program interview is conducted entirely in Chinese). 4.Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have a Chinese proficiency of at least HSK4 with a score of 180 or above. Applicants with higher scores will be given priority. (Applicants whose highest degree was taught entirely in Chinese may submit a "Medium of Instruction Certificate" from their institution instead of an HSK report). Note: This program can apply for scholarship. Any questions, please contact CUCAS counsleors.
